leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define TypeScript interfaces to structure notification data with required properties
Implement useState hook to store and manage an array of notification objects
Apply array iteration methods to render each notification in the UI
Utilize conditional rendering to display different notification types (success, error, warning)
Construct event handler functions to add new notifications to the state
Execute setTimeout functions to automatically remove notifications after a duration
Use React props to pass notification data between parent and child components
Implement a clear function to remove all notifications from the state
Apply CSS classes conditionally to style notifications based on their type
Control component visibility with boolean state to show/hide the notification system
